Cohesive botanical gallery palette: sage and forest greens, muted ochre, soft atmospheric blue. Depict an ecosystem: an interconnected community of living things in their environment. A lush freshwater pond at golden morning, luminous lily leaves and reeds, small fish visible beneath translucent foreground water, a heron quietly at the far bank, dragonflies above the water, an old willow sheltering the edge and a living patchwork of wetland plants.
